title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Robert Half Technology (Canada) inventory searched across six target-family keywords, scoped to Contract / Temporary to Hire only. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Re-run September 21, 2026 — confirms the 2026-09-19 finding: no eligible target-family contract postings. Refined workaround this run (see Search limitations) narrows results to Contract/Temp-to-Hire directly, rather than reviewing every fuzzy match.

notes_sections.heading: Search limitations — documented retrieval method still broken, refined workaround
items: The SKILL.md-documented URL pattern https://www.roberthalf.com/ca/en/jobs?jobType=CONTRACT&specialty=TECHNOLOGY&keywords=<term> still does not filter results as of this run — all six keyword fetches (direct HTTP and a live browser on the identical URL) returned the same unfiltered default listing (payroll, HR, and accounting roles). Confirmed again this run.

Refined workaround: submit each keyword through the on-page search box (redirects to https://www.roberthalf.com/ca/en/jobs/all/<keyword-slug>), then apply the page's own Job Type filter chip and select Contract / Temporary to Hire before reviewing results. This reliably scopes to contract-only postings client-side and avoids reviewing dozens of Permanent/Temporary fuzzy matches that the skill's contract-only mandate excludes anyway.

This is a skill-maintenance item: .agents/skills/check-roberthalf/SKILL.md's Access section should be updated to this UI-driven workaround; flagged here rather than edited directly since it wasn't asked for.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: No CAPTCHA or blocking challenge encountered.
All retrieval was read-only; no application, account, or form action was used.

rows.title: Senior Director Engineering
rows.location: Toronto, ON — on-site/hybrid implied ("local engineering presence," "represent the Toronto development centre")
rows.gap: Toronto is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal) — hard geography gate on its own. Separately, the role requires formal budget and headcount ownership across engineering/QA/DevOps/SRE functions (10+ years progressive engineering leadership) — a genuine mismatch against Marc's 'leads without authority' positioning, which has the substance of cross-team technical leadership but no formal management title, tenure, or P&L/headcount authority at director scale.
